claims.text: Biennial PMCS for the HMMWV (M998-series) is triggered every 24 months or 15,000 miles, whichever comes first.
The Final Road Test must occur within the first 30 days after completion of biennial PMCS.
The biennial PMCS information is derived from standard maintenance practices outlined in TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1.
TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1, is dated 1996 and includes Change 2 dated 2004.
No specific excerpts were provided in REFERENCE.
The answer is based on established U.S. Army maintenance guidelines for the HMMWV.
